VBO:0200184.summary: The Bochi, also called Boston Huahua, is a Boston Terrier–Chihuahua cross.
VBO:0200184.shortDescription: A Boston Terrier–Chihuahua cross, also called Boston Huahua.

sources.title: Dog Breed Info — Boston Huahua original parentage accounts
sources.evidence: New actual source read: keeper of Keller explicitly calls dog Bochi and names Boston Terrier father/Chihuahua mother. Darla keeper independently names Boston Terrier mother/longhaired Chihuahua father. Alternate-name list includes Bochi and Boston Huahua. Only parentage and name mapping adopted, not puppy anatomy or behavior.
